```{r setup, include=FALSE}
Sys.getenv("CFBD_API_KEY")
```

```{r library-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(cfbfastR)
library(tidyverse)
```

### Download game results (2024)
*This pulls every FBS game - home team, away team, points, site, etc.*
```{r}
games_raw <- map_dfr(2024, ~ cfbd_game_info(year = .x))
```

### Clean up the key columns
```{r}
games <- games_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(home_points), !is.na(away_points)) %>%
  mutate(
    home_win = ifelse(home_points > away_points, 1, 0),
    point_diff = home_points - away_points
  )
```

### Save for offline use
```{r}
if(!dir.exists("data")) dir.create("data")
write_csv(games, "data/games_2024.csv")
```

```{r}
glimpse(games)
summary(games$home_win)
```
